# AA Residency Tirupati

> AA Residency is a family-friendly hotel on Renigunta Road, Auto Nagar, Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh, India. It offers AC and Non-AC rooms, free Wi-Fi, parking and a 24/7 front desk, and takes bookings directly by website, WhatsApp and phone.

## Key facts

- Address: 22-11-246/1, Gollavani Gunta, Renigunta Road, Auto Nagar, Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh 517501, India
- Coordinates: 13.6294864, 79.4527874
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 87900 57559
- Email: info@aaresidency.com
- Check-in: 12:00 PM. Check-out: 11:00 AM.
- Front desk: open 24/7
- Amenities: free Wi-Fi, parking, AC and Non-AC rooms, hot water, power backup, banquet hall for events (packages: Occasional Functions ₹30,000; Corporate Meetings ₹25,000; both suit up to 200 people)
- Booking: direct with the hotel through the website, WhatsApp or phone
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/9AdeCWiaTHM4nEQW8

## Rooms and rates (per night, indicative)

- Deluxe Room (Non-AC): from ₹1,200, up to 2 adults, about 220 sq ft
- Studio Room (AC): from ₹1,800, up to 2 adults, about 220 sq ft
- Family Room (AC): from ₹2,200, up to 4 adults, about 220 sq ft

Current rates and availability are confirmed by the hotel when you book.

## Distances by road (approximate)

- Tirumala Temple: about 22 km
- Sri Govindaraja Swamy Temple: about 5 km
- Tirupati Railway Station: about 3 km
- Tirupati Bus Stand: about 2 km
- Tiruchanur Padmavathi Temple: about 3 km
